readout.notes: No server. BH ran the quyet package in-process (quyet_local.py adapter, common/run_v15.py driver) inside the vLLM image python. Option-letter next-token probabilities with the package calibration temperatures. A local installer would have to ship or re-implement the quyet package; the plain transformers path also exists per the card.
readout.portable_notes: The unmodified author library/CLI accepts CPU or MPS and keeps BF16 in its LLM loader: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ncchinh/quyet/f9bddb97bf0e39c8c965a85c0c6c5d1295224b6a/src/quyet/cli.py L18: p.add_argument("--device", help="cpu, cuda, cuda:1, ... (default: cuda if available)"); L21: model = load(a.model, device=a.device). https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ncchinh/quyet/f9bddb97bf0e39c8c965a85c0c6c5d1295224b6a/src/quyet/llm/runtime.py L22: dtype = dtype or torch.bfloat16; L29: model = model.to(device). 31B CPU execution is technically selectable but not practical; no CPU installer variant is offered. BF16 62.546 GB +25% =78.18 GB (~72.8 GiB), so a 64 GB Mac cannot fit; only a 96 GB+ Mac candidate is added, unbenchmarked. Readout is in-process and requires its calibrated label probabilities; backend_agnostic=false.

steps: Pull the pinned image vllm/vllm-openai:v0.30.0@sha256:8a69ffad... (only for its python 3.12.3 / torch 2.13.0+cu130 / transformers 5.17.0 runtime).
Fetch chinhnc/Quyet-1.0-Large at e1ecbbe7; verify MANIFEST.sha256 and pinned shard sha256 7e06d4a9... and f06a5e11....
Put quyet src (github.com/ncchinh/quyet @ f9bddb9) on sys.path; run quyet_local.QuyetLocalAdapter with model_dir=<snapshot>, device=cuda, dtype bf16.
Run with --network none, --read-only, --cap-drop ALL, no-new-privileges (BH hardening).

measured.gpu: RTX PRO 6000 96GB (BH meta.json gpu RTXPRO6000; quyet-common NOTES: Large on RTX PRO 6000)

variants.expected_speed: About 0.12 s p 50 per decision on the BH RTX PRO 6000 (serial, raw). Expect roughly 0.1-0.2 s per decision on a similar 96 GB card; not measured elsewhere. Provisioning class: RTX PRO 6000 96 GB; this names a memory class, not a latency measurement or confirmation of architecture compatibility. CPU/Mac speed is estimated only in separate portable variants.
variants.notes: BH measured on RTX PRO 6000 (v1.5 fast-lane run was H100). min_vram_gb 70 is BH meta.json; recommended 96 is the BH card. 62.6 GB of bf16 weights on disk. Not a server: the installer needs the quyet package, not a stock vLLM server. Host RAM provisioning estimate: pinned weight files sum to 62.546 GB; ×1.25 loader/runtime allowance rounded up to 4 GB gives 80 GB. This is not a measured peak; FP32 initialization or duplicate weight buffers may require more.
